```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

source("R/config.R")
source("R/teams.R")
source("R/fetch_table.R")
source("R/scoring.R")
source("R/predictions.R")
source("R/render_helpers.R")

TEAMS   <- load_teams()
PLAYERS <- load_players()
PREDS   <- load_active_predictions(teams = TEAMS)

# build.R refreshes the cache once per build; the pages read the cache so a
# three-page render is one API call, not three.
LIVE    <- get_live_table(refresh = FALSE)
RES     <- score_all(PREDS, LIVE, players = PLAYERS)

SEASON_STARTED <- sum(LIVE$played) > 0
```
